footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to RBC: after C$7.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 40-F for fiscal years ended Oct 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 16.1% to C$66.6B in fiscal 2025 (ended Oct 31, 2025). Operating income rose 29.1% to C$25.7B, a 38.5% margin.
Net income rose 25.5% to C$20.4B, or C$14.07 per share. Operating cash flow was C$55.2B and free cash flow C$55.2B, versus C$23.1B.
highlights: Free cash flow rose 2.4× to C$55.2B.
watch: Cash ended the year at C$87.4B.
sources: Royal Bank of Canada Form 40-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
